quarterly_data.quarter: Apple press release: Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant, (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Siri AI began rolling out in beta in English with Apple's 2027 software releases (French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish next month). The new capabilities are 'powered by the next generation of Apple Foundation Models, custom-built in collaboration with Google and its Gemini models', and 'these latest models run on device and on servers using Private Cloud Compute'; systemwide dictation uses Apple's most advanced on-device model, AFM Core Advanced. Server-side features (Siri AI, intelligent photo editing tools, Image Playground, AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts) are subject to daily usage limits that 'may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand', and 'expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future'. Siri AI will not be available initially in the EU on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS, and Siri AI and the other new Apple Intelligence features will not be available in China while Apple works through regulatory requirements.
quarterly_data.figure: Siri AI beta rolling out; models built with Google Gemini, run on device and on Private Cloud Compute servers; server features usage-limited, paid expanded access planned
